entries.title: II Timothy 4:1
segments: I charge [thee] in the sight of God, and of Christ Jesus, who shall judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:

entries.title: II Timothy 4:2
segments: preach the word; be urgent in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:3
segments: For the time will come when they will not endure the sound doctrine; but, having itching ears, will heap to themselves teachers after their own lusts;

entries.title: II Timothy 4:4
segments: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside unto fables.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:5
segments: But be thou sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfil thy ministry.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:6
segments: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure is come.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:7
segments: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:

entries.title: II Timothy 4:8
segments: henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give to me at that day; and not to me only, but also to all them that have loved his appearing.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:9
segments: Give diligence to come shortly unto me:

entries.title: II Timothy 4:10
segments: for Demas forsook me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:11
segments: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee; for he is useful to me for ministering.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:12
segments: But Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:13
segments: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, bring when thou comest, and the books, especially the parchments.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:14
segments: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord will render to him according to his works:

entries.title: II Timothy 4:15
segments: of whom do thou also beware; for he greatly withstood our words.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:16
segments: At my first defence no one took my part, but all forsook me: may it not be laid to their account.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:17
segments: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me; that through me the message might me fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:18
segments: The Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will save me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom [be] the glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:19
segments: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:20
segments: Erastus remained at Corinth: but Trophimus I left at Miletus sick.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:21
segments: Give diligence to come before winter. Eubulus saluteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:22
segments: The Lord be with thy spirit. Grace be with you.
